name: Guile of the Raptor
summary: Tor'gan's orb has filled Gor'mul with a raptor's essence. The power makes him wonder about shaman magic, and he will hear Tor'gan out for now.

sections.title: A Warrior Convinced
sections.body: Power runs through Gor'mul, and he wonders if it is the shamans' power Tor'gan tried to show him. The thought interests him. So he asks you to tell Tor'gan he is convinced for now and will hear what Tor'gan has to say.

sections.title: Tor'gan's Reply
sections.body: Tor'gan will speak with Gor'mul once the enchantment wears off. He thanks you for helping bring Gor'mul back among the living. Gor'mul is grateful too, Tor'gan believes.

faq.q: Who sends you to speak with Tor'gan?
aliases: who starts guile of the raptor 3
faq.answer: Gor'mul sends you to speak with Tor'gan. After feeling the orb's power, he asks you to say he is convinced for now.

faq.q: Why does Gor'mul change his mind about Tor'gan?
aliases: why did gormul change his mind
faq.answer: Gor'mul wonders whether the power he felt came from the shamans, as Tor'gan tried to show him. The thought interests him, so he is convinced for now and will listen to Tor'gan.
You brought Tor'gan's orb to Gor'mul in the earlier step.
